verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's own documentation includes a dedicated "Custom Agent Skill Developer Guide", and the homepage advertises "Custom Agent Skills". That indicates a first-party, documented format for writing your own skills. The evidence consists only of page titles, though, so the format details and the process for loading a skill into a local instance are not shown. Missing for 10: details of the skill format or schema, documented steps for loading a custom skill into a local instance, and independent or hands-on reports of building and loading one.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write my own skill, tool, or plugin against a documented format and load it into my instance locally

citations.quote: get a privacy-focused, extensible, and capable AI agent running on your device in minutes
